verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device and hosted model-serving SDK and platform, so serving embedding models is a fair axis for it. The evidence documents LLM, STT, TTS, VAD, diarization, VLM and image generation APIs, plus an OpenAI-compatible cloud endpoint. None of it mentions embedding models, an embeddings API, or retrieval/search use.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve embedding models for retrieval and search applications
